C:S1.1.text: UMB Healthcare Services, a division of UMB Financial, acts as an HSA custodian for employers and also offers other employer benefit accounts.

C:S2.1.text: The division handles custodial services for health savings accounts (HSAs) and private label, multipurpose debit cards for various organizations, including employers.

C:S3.1.text: Its 2021 launch of benefit spending accounts is described as a new suite of tax-advantaged benefit accounts that complements its current health savings accounts solution offered to employers.
